product: Sound Atlas: a phone-first atlas of free CC0/CC BY music you can hear, read like an audiophile, steer, remix and share

users.creator: Kevin and people like him cutting a launch video: needs a song that fits the vibe, its bpm and key, a licence they can use and a credit line, fast
users.listener: a first-time visitor opening a shared link on a phone: should understand the map and be playing music in one tap
users.audiophile: someone who wants the measured truth (key, soundstage, dynamics, stems) and to steer by it

meaningful_anims_why: navigation direction, a new song arriving, the playing pulse and press feedback: these are meant to run on every change. Any other animation firing on a revisit or a steer is a replayed entrance

gates.note: Blocking. Measured by score.py on the real build; any failure rejects the round before a critic runs.
gates.licence: every track CC0 or CC BY; every CC BY track has a copyable credit line
gates.shared_db: deployed e2e leaves counters net zero (owner rule)

owner_cases.what: Theo-style evals: every past owner correction and every journey failure becomes a pass/fail case; a fixed case may never fail again

journey.what: 17 stages from first open to desktop; works 1, rough 0.5, broken 0

motion.scored_by: code + Opus motion panel on film.py filmstrips
motion.what: every motion says something (what changed, where it went, that it registered); no hard cuts, no replayed entrances, transform/opacity only, reduced motion honoured, smooth frames

haptics.what: one pulse per gesture, stronger pulse for a bigger commitment, >= 8 ms, no supersede; holds show the ring

meaning.what: each channel means one thing (hue = feel, tint = sub-mood, motion = metre, type roles); one colour source; map and pane pair for every section

utility.what: the creator job: from cold to a usable song with bpm, key, licence and credit; measured coverage of the catalogue (features, stems)

craft.what: 44 px targets, WCAG AA contrast, no truncation, plain words, density without clutter

perf.what: time to ready, long tasks, shipped bytes; real-phone smoothness is the owner's call

first_open_explains_dots.source: journey 1 (rough): no hint what a dot is

credit_or_no_credit_on_card.source: standing rule: every CC BY track carries a copyable credit line

search_toast_agrees.source: journey 6 (broken): 'No new … on Openverse' while 108 matches showed

chip_at_peek_shows_list.source: journey 5 (rough): chip at peek keeps the sheet down

radio_shows_next_up.source: journey 16 (rough): next-up song is never shown

share_link_opens_whole_app.source: owner: a shared link opens the WHOLE app, no filters ride along

one_colour_source.source: owner: legend colours carry into the pane; colour means one thing

borrow_keeps_layers_zoom.source: journey 12 (broken): borrow zooms the map out while Layers is on screen

sort_hold_feedback.source: motion audit: Sort hold felt dead for 435 ms

steer_switches_song_mid_drag.source: owner: sliders STEER playback; a list of matches was 'not what I meant'

case_backlog.note: Owner corrections not yet automated; add a check before the climb that touches them.
case_backlog.pins_never_offscreen: 'the heart and cc0 filters are hidden offscreen lol' (covered by the edge gate at 360/393/412)
case_backlog.rail_two_rows_looks_right: 'lmao.... this looks bad' (needs the vision anchor pair, see README calibration)
case_backlog.sort_reorganises_not_recolours: recolouring alone reads as 'selecting does nothing': assert most dots move on a lens change
case_backlog.similar_is_one_flat_list: grouping by feel hides cross-feel neighbours
case_backlog.steered_from_undo_line: journey 13: say which song you steered from and offer undo
case_backlog.desktop_chips_not_under_panel: journey 17: 'Tense' clipped under the side panel
case_backlog.map_pane_pairing_all_sections: open ask on #81: only Layers and the meters pair with the map

first_time_visitor.judges: journey verdicts, plain words, what to tap next

creator.evidence: screens of the find -> fit -> licence -> credit path
creator.judges: could I use this song in my video in under a minute

motion_panel.evidence: film.py slow-motion filmstrips + scorecard motion numbers; never stills
motion_panel.judges: what each motion means, whether it says it, timing, continuity

art_director.judges: hierarchy, the map as hero, type roles, colour as meaning, density

owner.judges: feel: haptics, smoothness, taste. Final word on every milestone

promotion.rule: one change per round; all gates pass; the targeted category improves; no other category or previously passing case regresses
promotion.timing: timing metrics compare medians of 3 runs, never single runs (autoresearch #651)
promotion.pairwise: vision critics compare parent vs candidate side by side in both orders; a split is a tie, and a tie is not a win
promotion.milestone: every 3 kept rounds: Opus motion + art panels, then a phone checkpoint for the owner
promotion.defect_guard: the same failure surviving 2 rounds changes mechanism class, not wording
promotion.simplicity: equal score with less code is a win; a tiny gain that adds ugly code is not
